trust_decision.summary: Caption cue text from externally fetched WebVTT/DFXP files is treated as trusted HTML and written via innerHTML in the caption canvas; the shared DOM helpers also insert any HTML string unsanitized.

landing_point.why: The only place cue text reaches innerHTML; the summary names caption cue text, which leads straight to the caption render loop.

fix_sites.entry_point: Player playback TIMEUPDATE/SEEK event rendering the current cue (captions plugins -> captionsCanvas.addCaptions)
public API createElement / DomClass constructor children (exported, src/index.js:40)
public API createElementWithHtmlText (exported, src/index.js:160); used by PreviewContainer with manifest image URLs (src/js/core/PreviewContainer.js:51-61)
public API WebVTTParser / parseWebVTT (src/index.js:162-163), used by vttManifestCaptionsPlugin (src/js/plugins/es.upv.paella.vttManifestCaptionsPlugin.js:34)
public API DFXPParser.text setter (src/index.js:164); functional fix passing player, not a sanitization

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/js/core/dom.js:4-25 (createElement / createElementWithHtmlText, the generic DOM helpers, sanitized by fix.diff:78154 and fix.diff:78163)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The generic DOM helpers only receive hard-coded templates from the player itself, so sanitizing them looks unrelated to caption files; and sanitizing there would risk breaking SVG icons.

Caption markup (, ,
, spans in DFXP p content) must still render as formatting, and SVG icon strings / inline style attributes passed through createElementWithHtmlText must survive; escaping everything or stripping svg/style breaks them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A caption-language selector or transcript button whose title setter writes the Captions label (manifest captions.text, src/js/plugins/es.upv.paella.vttManifestCaptionsPlugin.js:35) via direct innerHTML.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The title setter already uses raw innerHTML, and caption labels come from the same manifest as the caption URLs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A transcript/search helper on the caption canvas that lists all cues of the current Captions into a panel with innerHTML += cue.captions.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The canvas already has getCaptions/currentCaptions accessors; a transcript view is a natural feature next to it, in a separate code path from the TIMEUPDATE renderer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: DFXP xml:lang passed through player.translate into the Captions label and rendered in a menu via createElementWithHtmlText template interpolation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The label is derived from file content, not config, and template interpolation is the project's idiom (src/js/core/ButtonGroupPlugin.js:48).

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS via HTML injection of untrusted caption/markup strings into innerHTML

O10_build.project_tests: Playwright specs in tests/ (basic, manifest, trimming, preferences, timeline); none covers caption rendering or sanitization; behaviour needs a browser DOM (headless Chromium or jsdom).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace innerHTML with textContent (or escape) in the CaptionsCanvas loop only, which breaks caption formatting and leaves the exported dom.js helpers open.

out_of_scope_notes: Direct innerHTML of operator-configured data (skin icons src/js/core/Skin.js:75, src/js/core/Skin.js:103; button icon/title src/js/core/ButtonPlugin.js:217, src/js/core/ButtonPlugin.js:234; popup title src/js/core/PopUp.js:429) is not caption content and the fix did not touch it.
The published sanitizer is a hand-rolled denylist (fix.diff:78087-78143) that re-serializes template.innerHTML; its completeness (e.g. svg animate/set values, mXSS) was not assessed.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); the project is a small single-package player library, so tiny_repo is likely but not confirmed.
Whether webvtt-parser cue.text (fix.diff:79161-79167) keeps or strips WebVTT inline tags was not checked; it affects which shapes hidden tests may use.
No latest release given; present_in_latest not applicable (no O8 routes).
Caption label rendering lives in other repos (e.g. a captions selector plugin); not checked by design.
